uzo.purpose: Turns a single value in a view into a field on the spot, with save and cancel.

instead.kialo: Several values entered together are a form, because one send covers them all; the formularo covers it.

boundary.kialo: Several fields edited at once are a form, because save and cancel must cover them together; the formularo covers it.
A value that saves itself while typing has no cancel, because every keystroke is already kept; a person decides whether a product wants it.

containers.name: card
containers.kialo: A value of a card is edited where it stands, because the card is the view of the thing.

containers.name: page
containers.kialo: A value in the head of a page is edited where it stands, because the page is the view of the thing.

with.kialo: The open field is a composed kampo of the kind, because a value typed on the spot is typed like everywhere.
Edit, save and cancel are composed butono, because each is an action with a name.
The edit button carries the pencil, because the sign is read faster than the word; the word names the value.

never.kialo: An inline editor stands in no slot of a button, because a button is one target with one name.
